```{r}

homicides <- read.csv("../data/homicide-data.csv")
head(homicides)

```
```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

baltimore_data <- homicides %>% 
  filter(city == "Baltimore") %>% 
  mutate(date = ymd(reported_date),
         month = month(date),
         year = year(date),
         season = if_else(month(date) >= 5 & month(date) <= 10,
                          "Summer", "Winter")) 
baltimore_data
```
```{r}
  
total_homicides <- baltimore_data %>% 
  group_by(year, month, season) %>% 
  summarise(homicides = n())
total_homicides
```
